description: This Java source file defines an enumeration 'FieldType' representing different types of JSON fields, including REGULAR, SPECIAL, and HIDDEN. It implements predicates for filtering JSON fields based on their type and visibility, and provides static methods returning predicates for common filtering scenarios.

classes.name: FieldType
classes.description: Enumeration of JSON field types providing predicate logic for filtering JSON fields based on their type and visibility.

methods.name: notHidden
methods.description: Returns a predicate that identifies JSON fields not marked as HIDDEN.

methods.name: regularOrSpecial
methods.description: Returns a predicate that identifies JSON fields marked as REGULAR or SPECIAL.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a predicate that matches all JSON fields.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Implements the Predicate interface to test whether a JsonField matches the current predicate.
